_comment: Selected theatres for the Multiplex Report (multiplex_report.py). Add/remove entries here without touching code.
_match: 'match' strings are matched case-insensitively against the field chosen by 'match_field'. Whitespace differences are ignored.
_match_field: 'chain' (default) = chain/company name (falls back to venue if chain is Unknown/blank). 'venue' = the row's 'venue' string only, e.g. 'AMB Cinemas: Gachibowli'. 'location' = venue + address.
_match_type: 'contains' (default) = substring match. 'exact' = the whole venue string must equal the match string (safest for venues).
_split_by_venue: 'split_by_venue': true on a chain entry makes every distinct venue of that chain its own row in the report, no need to list venues by hand.
